page_text:
January 14, 2019 

Denise J. McNerney 
Merits Cases Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States  
One First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  No. 17-1606, Smith v. Berryhill 

Dear Ms. McNerney: 

As  the  Court-appointed  amicus  curiae  in  support  of  the  judgment  below,  I  write  to 
modify  my  previous  request  for  an  extension  of  the  briefing  schedule  in  light  of  additional 
scheduling  conflicts.  I  have  conferred  with  counsel  for  the  parties,  both  of  whom  consent  to 
this new request.  

The  amicus  brief  in  support  of  the  judgment  below  is  currently  due  on  January  22.  I 
respectfully request an  extension of that deadline, to and including February 4. The parties’ 
replies would then be due on March 6. 

Thanks very much for your attention to this matter. 

Sincerely, 

Deepak Gupta 
Court-Appointed Amicus Curiae
